newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CS First Boston rates Solvay sell.
newsitem.headline: CS First Boston rates Solvay sell.

text.p: COMMENT: On the basis of the rather mediocre outlook for polymers over the next two years earnings trends will be no better than flat in the medium term. Solvay looks somewhat expensive,to say the least, relative to comparable stocks in the sector. The stock enjoys support on two grounds: management's commitment not to cut dividend if at all possible (550 bfr net) and Solvay's position as a blue chip stock and Belgium's second-largest industrial concern.
Neverthless, if weightings in Belgium are not a consideration, more attractive investments can be found elsewhere in the sector.
Recommendation: SELL. Analysts: Penny Tattershall, Simon Brown. (*) Date of research report: 04/11/96
